answer: The cooper hoops every barrel with iron he stamped himself, and the cellarman counts the hoops before he fills it. Prosthetist registration with health council attestation is the stamp on the iron: four-year degree, 1,000 clinical hours, registration exam, annual renewal. A barrel hooped with a borrowed voyage bursts at the first filling and soaks the cellar floor. The wander is the loss, the wine and the barrel both paid for by the cooper, and the ferrous is the yard book, kept by the master cooper and read when the rents are due.
